documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Financial Results (Both Standalone And Consolidated), For The Quarter Ended On 30Th June, 2026 ('Financial Results')
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for FY26, with revenue from operations growing 25% year-on-year to over INR2,255 crores and net profit increasing by 48% to INR1,306 million. The growth was supported by robust demand in the domestic agricultural sector-accelerated by GST-led narrowing of the price gap between two-wheel drive and four-wheel drive tractors-along with a positive export momentum in construction equipment. Looking ahead, the company maintains its long-term revenue target of INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY30, while adopting a cautious near-term outlook for FY27 due to macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainties. Carraro India Limited reported a strong performance in FY26, with revenue from operations growing 25% year-on-year to INR 22,555 million and PAT increasing by 48% to INR 1,306 million. Growth was supported by sustained domestic demand in agricultural vehicles, particularly 4WD axles following GST revisions, and robust export traction in construction equipment like Tele Boom Handlers.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of achieving revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: With improving industry sentiment, expanding opportunities across domestic and export markets, and strong execution momentum, we remain confident of achieving revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY ‘30, exceeding our earlier target.

guidance.claim: The management expects Start of Production for the Turkey program during FY27 and for the Indian customer program during FY28.
guidance.quote: We expect SOP, Start of Production, for the Turkey program during FY ‘27, while the Indian customer program is expected to enter production by FY ‘28.

guidance.claim: Management continues to target EBITDA margin improvement during FY27.
guidance.quote: On profitability, we continue to target EBITDA margin improvement during FY ‘27, supported by our continued focus on localization, operating efficiencies, value-accelerated product mix, and disciplined cost management initiatives.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company is confident of reaching or exceeding the earlier guidance of INR3,200 crores, moving close to INR3,500 crores.
guidance.quote: In view of improving off-highway market sentiment, our strong execution momentum, we are confident of possibly reaching but also exceeding the earlier guidance of INR3,200 crores, and we would be moving close to INR3,500 crore, which will be higher than our earlier target of INR3,200 crore, which we mentioned as EUR350 million at that point in time.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic construction equipment industry volumes declined by approximately 2% year-on-year due to slower infrastructure execution.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment side, the domestic market remained relatively soft, with industry volumes declining by approximately 2% year-on-year due to slower infrastructure execution and delays in project activity during parts of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports from India grew by nearly 32% in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: However, exports from India remained robust, growing by nearly 32%, reflecting improving global demand for Indian-manufactured construction equipment and strengthening India's position as an export hub.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment exports by Indian OEMs continued to witness healthy traction.
demand_outlook.quote: Construction equipment exports by Indian OEMs continued to witness healthy traction.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry outlook continues to be positive with tractor and allied equipment volumes expected to grow in the low to mid-teens this year.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry outlook continues to be positive with tractor and allied equipment volumes expected to grow in the low to mid-teens this year.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic four-wheel drive axle market delivered strong revenue growth in the first 9 months.
demand_outlook.quote: The domestic four-wheel drive axle market delivered strong revenue growth in the first 9 months, prompting Carraro India Limited to ramp up capacity to meet the anticipated demand ahead.

demand_outlook.claim: In the construction segment, sales of drive lines to Indian construction equipment customers increased by approximately 4% during the first nine months.
demand_outlook.quote: In the construction segment, sales of drive lines to the Indian construction equipment customers increased by approximately 4% during the first nine months, despite a decline of around 5% in the overall construction equipment market over the same period.

demand_outlook.claim: Sales of drive lines to backhoe loader customers in the domestic market grew by approximately 5% during the nine-month period.
demand_outlook.quote: Sales of drive lines to backhoe loader customers in the domestic market grew by approximately 5% during the nine-month period, significantly outperforming the broader market decline of nearly 12%.

capex_expansion.claim: During FY26, the company deployed capex of approximately INR417 million.
capex_expansion.quote: During FY ‘26, we deployed capex approximately of INR417 million towards new telescopic handler axle production, high-performance transmission programs, incremental manufacturing capacity expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: For FY27, capex is confirmed to be around INR130 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, we confirm that amount, more on the INR130 crores than INR140 crores, but we will be in that range.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board-approved capex to expand axle capacity to 1,54,160 units is aligned with the strong demand outlook.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board-approved capex to expand axle capacity to 1,54,160 units is aligned with our strong demand outlook and will support future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved a capex outlay of INR623 million to expand axle capacity from 1,34,000 units to up to 1,54,000 units over the next 18 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, the board has approved a capex outlay of INR623 million to expand our axle capacity from 1,34,000 units to up to 1,54,000 units over the next 18 months, to be funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt.

capex_expansion.claim: INR304 million was deployed during 9 months FY 2026 to support new telescopic handler axle production, high-performance range transmission, and incremental capacity additions.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to capex, INR304 million was deployed during 9 months FY 2026 to support new telescopic handler axle production, a high-performance range transmission for agriculture application, and incremental capacity additions for FY '26 sales.

capex_expansion.claim: Two sealed-quench furnaces were installed at the gear plant and an 800mm pallet Mazak machining center was commissioned in June.
capex_expansion.quote: Two sealed-quench furnaces were installed at the gear plant and the 800mm pallet Mazak machining center was commissioned in June, improving throughput and flexibility.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins improved to 10.8% in FY26 compared to 10.2% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins improved to 10.8% in FY ‘26 compared to 10.2% in FY ‘25, despite changes in product mix during the year.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material localization stood at approximately 78% during FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Raw material localization stood at approximately 78% during FY ‘26 and we remain on track to increase this to nearly 86% to 88% over the next two to three years.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improved meaningfully with EBITDA growing 28% year-on-year, supported by operating leverage, disciplined cost management, and execution efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: Profitability improved meaningfully during the period with EBITDA growing 28% year-on-year, supported by operating leverage, disciplined cost management, and execution efficiencies even as product mix remained dynamic across quarters.

margins_costs.claim: Total other income included about INR60 million pertaining to the reversal of provisions previously made for vendor payments.
margins_costs.quote: On the total other income, about INR60 million pertains to the reversal of provisions previously made for vendor payments.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a business nomination for a major OEM for bull gears valued at approximately INR150 million annually starting FY28.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year, we secured a business nomination for a major OEM for bull gears, valued at approximately INR150 million annually starting FY ‘28.

orders_capacity.claim: Engineering services reported revenues of approximately INR100 million during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Engineering services business continued to gain traction and reported revenues of approximately INR100 million during FY ‘26.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed an engineering services agreement worth approximately INR175 million with Montra Electric.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year, we signed an engineering services agreement worth approximately INR175 million with Montra Electric for the industrialization and supply of electric transmissions for tractors.

orders_capacity.claim: The engineering services business reported revenues of Rs. 100 million in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our engineering services business continued to gain traction, reporting revenues of Rs. 100 million in FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: In the gears business, the company secured a business nomination from a major OEM for bull gears, valued at approximately ~INR 15 crore p.a. effective FY28.
orders_capacity.quote: In the gears business, secured a business nomination from a major OEM for bull gears, valued at approximately ~INR 15 crore p.a. effective FY28.

orders_capacity.claim: The plant capacity is operating nearly at about 90% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: This expansion is aligned with our strong demand outlook, with the plant capacity operating nearly at about 90% utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Engineering services revenue for Carraro India stood at INR50 million in Q3 FY 2026 and INR100 million during 9 months FY 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Engineering services revenue for Carraro India stood at INR50 million in Q3 FY 2026 and INR100 million during 9 months FY 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: Innovation continued with 14 prototypes developed during the 9-month period, four of which have entered production.
orders_capacity.quote: Innovation continued to be a key focus during the 9-month period with 14 prototypes developed, four of which have entered production.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity ratio improved to 0.27x as of March 2026 compared to 0.42x in March 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-to-equity improved to 0.27x as of March 2026 compared to 0.42x in March 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days reduced to 38 days from 45 days in FY25.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days reduced to 38 days from 45 days in FY ‘25, reflecting tighter working capital management and operational discipline.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of INR6.75 per equity share for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: On the dividend front, the Board of Directors has recommended a final dividend of INR6.75 per equity share for FY ‘26, resulting in a payout ratio of approximately 30%, subject to shareholder approval.

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion capex is to be funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Additionally, the board has approved a capex outlay of INR623 million to expand our axle capacity from 1,34,000 units to up to 1,54,000 units over the next 18 months, to be funded through a mix of internal accruals and debt.

risks_headwinds.claim: Any sustained rise in energy prices or supply chain volatility could lead to production and supply-related impact, especially in H1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: Any sustained rise in energy prices or supply chain volatility could lead to some production and supply-related impact, especially in H1 FY ‘27 and potentially extend to H2 if the situation persists longer than anticipated.

risks_headwinds.claim: The gear business remained subdued during 9 months FY 2026, and near-term growth is likely to remain muted.
risks_headwinds.quote: The gear business remained subdued during 9 months FY 2026. Although near-term growth is likely to remain muted, ongoing initiatives to strengthen the business are expected to drive gradual improvement in the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: With improving industry sentiment, expanding opportunities across domestic and export markets, and strong execution momentum, we remain confident of achieving revenues of around INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY ‘30, exceeding our earlier target.

management_commitments.claim: Start of Production for the Turkey program is expected during FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect SOP, Start of Production, for the Turkey program during FY ‘27, while the Indian customer program is expected to enter production by FY ‘28.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase raw material localization to nearly 86% to 88% over the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: Raw material localization stood at approximately 78% during FY ‘26 and we remain on track to increase this to nearly 86% to 88% over the next two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: Efforts to acquire additional engineering services business are currently in progress.
management_commitments.quote: Efforts to acquire additional engineering services business are currently in progress.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains on track to increase raw material localization to 86% to 88%.
management_commitments.quote: Our raw material localization stood at 78%, and we remain on track to increase this to 86% to 88% in the next 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach INR3,500 crores revenues in FY 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Our north star remains INR3,500 crores revenues in FY 2030.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the capacity expansion to be deployed over an 18-month timeframe.
management_commitments.quote: Yes. So, this capacity, as we mentioned in our communication, will be deployed over 18 months.
